text: There seems to me at present to be great occasion for raising a United Party for Virtue, by forming the virtuous and good men of all nations into a regular body, to be govern'd by suitable good and wise rules, which good and wise men may probably be more unanimous in their obedience to, than common people are to common laws.
author: Benjamin Franklin
locator: Chapter IX, Plan for Attaining Moral Perfection, Observations on my reading history
